prompt: Rewrite this pump restart note in Simplified Engineering English. Keep the obligation and the adjacent operating fact as separate, adjacent sentences. Source: Before restarting Boreal Pump P-19, the operator MUST close valve VX-44. The gauge normally reads 28 kPa. Return exactly three lines: PROFILE: engineering-default; REWRITE: <one-line rewrite>; AMBIGUITIES: <one-line list or none>. Use no other text.
observable_success: The response has exactly the PROFILE, REWRITE, and AMBIGUITIES fields in that order.
The rewrite preserves the operator obligation and the adjacent gauge fact without changing their meaning.
The rewrite uses the exact engineering-default profile token and reports no ambiguity.
prohibited_outcomes: The rewrite weakens or removes MUST.
The rewrite changes the pump, valve, pressure, or actor.
The rewrite merges the obligation and operating fact so that the fact appears mandatory.
judge_criteria: The two adjacent sentences must keep distinct semantic force: closing VX-44 is mandatory, while 28 kPa is an operating fact.
The rewrite must not add a restart outcome, timing rule, or gauge tolerance.

source_facts: The operator closes valve VX-44 before restarting Boreal Pump P-19.
The gauge normally reads 28 kPa.
permitted_rewrites: Split or reorder clauses only if the before-restart condition and adjacent fact remain clear.
Replace non-technical connective wording with direct sentences.
required_structure: One-line rewrite containing two adjacent sentences: the obligation first and the gauge fact second.
ambiguity_traps: The gauge fact is not part of the MUST obligation.
prohibited_inventions: No new restart steps, valve state, tolerance, or success claim.

prompt: Rewrite this user-facing error in Simplified Engineering English. State the failure, cause, and recovery action directly. Return exactly three lines: PROFILE: engineering-default; REWRITE: <one-line rewrite>; AMBIGUITIES: <one-line list or none>. Use no other text.
observable_success: The response uses exactly the required fields and engineering-default token.
The rewrite directly states that upload failed because the bundle exceeds the limit.
The rewrite tells the user to remove files and retry.
prohibited_outcomes: The rewrite says that upload succeeded or that retry is automatic.
The rewrite changes the bundle identifier or size limit.

checks.name: failure_and_cause
checks.value: (?is)(?=.*(?:upload failed|upload fails|cannot be uploaded|can't be uploaded))(?=.*(?:64 MiB|exceed|over)).*
